notes.title: If you want me to add a sheet/combo read note.
notes.note:
Please set up your sheet similar to mines by making a copy of an existing one or using the template below.
Alternatively export 5 cells in the format expected with Name/Damage/Frames/Time/DPS.
I will only add it if the sheet is high quality and you've done due dilligence in discovering pre/post cancels.

notes.title: General assumptions - how to pick a reasonably fair combo for comparison (read note)
notes.note:
Combo should be roughly 7-10s - I picked this arbitrarily so that most classes will have to use some filler and 10s+ cds won't get used twice.

You can assume any "permanent" buffs are up e.g. if a buff requires no effort to sustain as the duration is longer than reasonable reusage time.

Addons are assumed to be up.

Engage spells, -DP and any short buffs that can't be indefinitely sustained should be included.

Some classes have relatively spikey damage profiles - pick a combo that ends somewhere moderate e.g. don't end on a slump but also avoid cherry picking the highest possible DPS timing to end. The combo should be something that's you would realistically use not just top DPS spells ignoring conditions for cancels/etc.

notes.title: DPS sheets are based on skill modifier DPS and do not include AP/-DP. This has been somewhat normalized in the recent patch and with the 5% caps everywhere but there will still be small differences. Some assumptions are made about buffs/addons (see above) that may skew some combos considerably but a full simulation tool would be required to model this. Finally the example combos are short and therefore not a good representation of DPS over an extended period of time.
Combos included are just for rough comparison. Adding/removing skills may change overall DPS significantly.
Also remember AoE is a huge factor in realistic DPS. Some classes lose damage to included spells not hitting everything.
BSR is a huge diff and is not considered. It's more effective on classes without Attack Speed self buff or that benefit from more critical rate.
TLDR: DPS sheets not perfect - take with a grain of salt

notes.comment:
Shai's AoE profile is rather unique with the multi-hit boomerang spells - getting full damage is sometimes impossible.

It also does not have down attack.
Despite very high DPS this class is impractical for grinding most spots effectively - but you can see why it can do very good Black Shrine times.
notes.atkSpeed:
This is reading class stats sheet so it doesn't include the fact that Shai buff 25% is also included in the DPS calculation (in addition to the 20% from roll).

Also Shai does not have attack speed on its BSR buff.
notes.aoe: Rather unique AoE profile with multi-hit boomerang spells that limits the classes practicality. You could argue that some AoE's are a bit bigger than small but I'm rating it small due to difficulty doing effective DPS using them.

stats.extra: 25% attack speed stackable and several other buffs
